description: Pre-registered in experiments/msm_stage_gemma/spec.md (roadmap R3a; spec v2 after skeptic review 2026-07-06: arm 2' added for a matched-instruct-scale stage contrast (A3 vs A2'), identical-AFT with ID-fit covariate, H3 re-anchored to pure confound endpoints with scoring-mode split, Gemma delta_apply/echo-guard/BOS work added to code plan, install+dissociation pilot gate for the Llama-framed corpus). Four MSM placements (incl. 2' at matched instruct scale) vs matched controls on google/gemma-4-12B(+-it), both chloeli values, pre-AFT (E) and +AFT (A) tiers; headline = OOD-gap on held-out-domain forced-choice evals, judge-free. Phase-0 gates before any full run: gemma-4 stack check (transformers/vLLM/Unsloth train->merge->serve), delta_apply tensor compat, Gemma template + assistant-only masking plumb, Gemma token accounting, ~$10 base-rate pilot (ceiling go/no-go), metric prerequisites (PLAN P1-7/9), leakage scan, smoke. Budget: seed 0 both values ~68 H100-h ~= $330-380 all-in; dev ~4-5 days. Decisions baked in (2026-07-06): combination = 1a released-delta transplant (1b out of scope); arms 1a/2 vs 3/4 instruct-scale confound accepted with caveat; seed 0 signs-of-life first.
title: msm_stage_gemma: MSM stage x combination on Gemma-4-12B (spec + phase 0 + seed-0 run)
